Professor Khen to Vikram and Diya: "We created a biological vessel. A young girl infused with massive dark energy—KERA's exact cosmic energy extracted from the dark dimension. Everything was mathematically perfect until she physically disappeared."
Diya to Professor Khen (whispering in realization): "Trinity…"
Khen nodded slowly.
Professor Khen to Diya: "She is not human. She is the cosmic key."
Diya to Professor Khen (spitting the words): "You experimented on an innocent child!"
Professor Khen to Diya (replying coldly): "She was scientifically created for exactly this purpose."
Vikram stepped forward, his eyes burning.
Vikram to Professor Khen: "Which means KERA is incomplete right now."
Professor Khen to Vikram: "For the moment."
He pointed a remote directly toward Thomas’s life support chamber.
Professor Khen to Vikram and Diya: "Bring me the strange girl…
or he dies."
Vikram’s absolute, lethal anger surged instantly. The heavily armed guards advanced, raising their stun batons.
Vikram stepped directly in front of Diya.
Vikram to Diya: "Stay behind me."

The first guard attacked violently. Vikram moved with terrifying, unnatural precision, dodging the strike and countering instantly with a bone-shattering blow to the man's ribs. Another guard struck Vikram across the back with a heavy baton with massive force.
Vikram did not even flinch. He slowly turned his head.
Diya stared in absolute disbelief.
Diya to Vikram: "You are not
feeling anything..."
Vikram to Diya (replying coldly, his eyes locked on the guards): "I am not."

More guards rushed him. Vikram fought relentlessly. His movements were highly controlled yet devastatingly aggressive, as if the dark matter exposure within his body had fully awakened his latent potential. He tore through the armored men like paper. The rogue scientists watched in absolute shock and wonder as their guards were dismantled.
Rogue Scientist to Another (whispering): "He does not respond to physical pain."
Vikram broke entirely through the guard line, clearing a path to the exit.
Vikram to Diya (shouting): "Run!"
Diya followed immediately. They sprinted down the steel corridors, finally escaping the underground nightmare and breaking for the surface.
Back at the campus, Shaun stood before the Sentinels, his head bowed.
Shaun to the Sentinels (admitting honestly): "I lost control earlier. Something demonic used my mind."
Chan to Shaun (replying sharply): "And that almost destroyed everything we built!"
Shaun to Chan: "I know. And I will fix it. With my life if I have to."
Payal to Shaun (asking cautiously): "Why should we trust you?"
Shaun to Payal: "Because I will never run again."
Ajay stepped in, clapping a hand on Shaun's shoulder.
Ajay to the Sentinels: "We need him. He knows the layout."
Chan nodded reluctantly.
Chan to Shaun: "Then prove it on the battlefield."
Shaun nodded, his resolve hardened.
Moments later, the heavy doors burst open. Vikram and Diya returned, exhausted but alive. Everyone gathered around them immediately.
Vikram quickly and precisely explained everything they had learned in the depths. The underground lab. Professor Khen. The cosmic dark entity, KERA. And Trinity’s true origin.
Vikram to the Sentinels (ending his
intense briefing): "Everything we are fighting was artificially created."
A heavy, suffocating silence followed the revelation.
Trinity stepped forward from the corner of the room, her pale eyes scanning the group.
Trinity to the Sentinels: "I can shut the massive dimensional gate down."
Chan to Trinity (asking incredulously): "You are the one who opened it?"
Trinity to Chan (replying softly): "Yes. But not willingly."
Diya to Trinity: "Then you can stop it. We will protect you."
Trinity nodded, a fierce determination replacing her usual blank stare.

title: FINAL OATH — THE SENTINELS
content: The storm outside raged, heavy rain battering the windows of their safe room. The atmosphere was thick with the grim reality of what they were about to do. They weren't just students anymore; they were soldiers walking into a warzone.
Vikram stepped forward, looking at the bruised, exhausted, but unbroken faces of his friends. He picked up a hunting knife from the table.
Vikram to the Sentinels: "We are walking into a graveyard tonight. Some of us might not walk out."
He pressed the blade to his palm, drawing a sharp, thin line of blood, and closed his fist.
Diya stepped up beside him. She took the blade without hesitation, slicing
her own palm and gripping his bloody hand.
Diya to the Sentinels: "Then we make sure we take that graveyard down with us."
Ajay stepped forward, racking the slide of his heavy sidearm. He took the blade, cutting his palm and joining their grip.
Ajay to the Sentinels: "No one fights alone."
Chan adjusted his tactical gear, taking the blade next.
Chan to the Sentinels: "No one dies alone."
Shaun stepped in, completing the circle, his own blood mixing with the rest.
Shaun to the Sentinels: "For the ones we lost. And the ones we will
save."
They stood tightly together, a circle of blood and iron, bound by a promise that transcended friendship.
Vikram to the Group: "We hold the line."
Diya to the Group: "Whatever it takes."
The Sentinels (in a low, gritty, unbreakable chorus): "We are the Sentinels."

title: POST CREDIT SCENE
content: Deep within the observation deck of the MIA black-site, Nova stood rigidly, staring at the massive bank of classified monitors. On the screens, the feed from Thomas's containment chamber flickered wildly, the digital readouts bleeding into incomprehensible, alien symbols.
He turned his sharp gaze toward Helen, who was watching the monitors with a faint, knowing smile.
Nova to Helen (asking with deep suspicion): "What is happening to Thomas in there?"
Helen didn't look away from the screens. The thick, reinforced glass of Thomas's chamber began to spiderweb with massive, glowing cracks.
Helen to Nova: "He has the unique cognitive ability to control minds, reshape absolute thoughts, and alter physical reality itself."
Nova stepped closer to the glass, his breath catching in his throat as the heavy alarms began to blare.
Nova to Helen: "So that is how he managed to resist the dark realm's
influence..."

The monitors suddenly shattered into a shower of sparks. Inside the chamber, Thomas opened his eyes. They were no longer human. They glowed with KERA's exact cosmic energy, but purified, radiating a blinding, terrifying light.
Helen smiled faintly, the reflection of the glowing energy dancing across her face.
Helen to Nova: "He didn't just resist the realm, Nova. He became its new architect."

title: THE FINAL BREACH
content: The Dark Dimension breathed like a dying, heavy lung. The air was thick with ash and the metallic scent of old blood. Eldora stood amidst the crushing darkness, her jaw tight. The Supreme Entity’s command echoed in her skull: bring Sara alive, but slaughter the children. She arrived at the decaying pillar where Sara had been bound, only to find the heavy chains dangling uselessly. Sara had heard everything between Eldora and Kera. Sara was gone.

A guttural scream ripped from Eldora’s throat, shaking the cavern walls. In full, unhinged rage, she slammed her staff into the ground. The earth cracked. From the fissures, a massive, writhing army of shadow-scourge clawed their way to the surface. But

behind them, something far more terrifying stirred. Out of focus, obscured by a dense, suffocating fog, six towering silhouettes slowly rose. The Void-Reaper Crowns. They were not fully visible, merely terrifying, dim shapes that blotted out what little light remained—a silent, creeping promise of an apocalyptic future yet to unfold.

Parallelly, deep within the labyrinth of the dark dimension, Sara crept through the shadows. She found the abducted children sealed inside suffocating, enclosed chambers. Dark, pulsating veins of energy siphoned their life force, injecting it directly into a massive, central monolithic core. Recognizing the catastrophic threat, Sara moved with desperate precision.
She shattered the connecting conduits one by one, forcefully disconnecting every child's pod from the main chamber.

The children spilled out, coughing and terrified. Sara gathered them quickly, her maternal instinct taking over. They began a tense, agonizingly stealthy escape. The corridors crawled with shadow-scourge hunting for her. Sara guided the children through the ruins, pressing them against damp walls and hiding them in the wreckage whenever a patrol passed, turning their desperate flight into a masterclass of survival and breath-holding tension.
Parallelly, inside the Sentinel Main Hall, chaos reigned. Krish roared, his
veins burning pitch-black as the dark matter took absolute control. He violently threw himself at the Sentinel equipment, tearing metal with his bare hands.
Vikram to Varun: "Pin his legs! Don't let him move!"

Varun tackled his brother’s lower body while Vikram locked his arms in a crushing grip, fighting the supernatural strength with raw, desperate muscle. They managed to bind his wrists and ankles with heavy-duty restraints, tying a thick cloth over his eyes to disorient the entity within. They dragged him into the isolation dark room, the air thick with tension and the heavy breathing of exhausted warriors.
Diya to Vikram: "The dark matter
inside him must be ejected forcefully, Vikram. If we don't, it's going to mutate... it's going to do something irreversible to my younger brother."
She broke down, tears tracking through the grime on her face. Seeing her mourn shattered Vikram. His eyes hardened with sudden realization.
Vikram to Diya: "We haven't tried using the electric stabbers, right? Shock the nervous system, disrupt the entity's hold."

Vikram grabbed a high-voltage electric stabber and drove it directly into Krish’s chest plate. Krish’s body arched violently off the table, trembling and vibrating under the immense electrical surge. He shrieked, but for a split second, a black, viscous mist violently pushed out of his pores
before snapping back in.
Diya to Vikram: "You got the solution, Vikram! Now we know the way to cure him. Let's finish this properly without any mistakes."
Vikram to the Sentinels: "We are out of time. We need to part into teams and execute this from all fronts. We end this today."

Parallelly, the sterile lights of the underground lab flickered. Dr. Sebastin stepped through the ruined sliding doors, surveying the massive destruction Vikram had caused earlier. Half of Sebastin's face was a horrific map of severe, molten burns. Dr. Khen, who had been hiding behind a console, stepped out, his face draining of color.
Dr. Khen to Dr. Sebastin: "You... you're alive? You look like a
completely new man."
Dr. Sebastin to Dr. Khen: "The explosion caused me severe facial burns. Officially, the records say I am dead. But science changes everything. Now, I am a 'dead man walking' fueled entirely by rage."
Sebastin walked slowly toward the reinforced glass chamber where Thomas floated, unconscious and under observation.
Dr. Khen to Dr. Sebastin: "What are we going to do with this guy? Shall I kill him? He is completely useless to us now."
Dr. Sebastin to Dr. Khen: "No. He is the key to the entire group. He is too important. Spare him."
Parallelly, inside the Sentinel Common Room, the atmosphere was electric.
Weapons clicked, armor was secured, and the air crackled with the heavy, impending weight of war. Vikram stood at the center, charting the assault.
TEAM ALPHA: Ajay leading the elite rescue and force team. Mission: Breach the open dimension gate, rescue the children, and bring Sara back.
TEAM BETA: Vikram (superhuman combat) and Varun (cellular regeneration). Mission: Hold the frontline. Defend the gate against the impending wave of entities.
TEAM GAMMA: Chase, Ron, Mike, and Teren, backed by the tactical force team. Mission: Hack the lab's mainframes, secure the experiment data, and extract Thomas from the
pod. The force team defends them from any scientists trying to stop the operation.

TEAM DELTA: Diya, Payal, Chan, Shaun, and Brandt. Mission: Defend the isolation room and forcefully over-energize Krish using coordinated electric stabbers from different sides to expel the dark matter.
TEAM ZETA: Trinity. Mission: The ultimate failsafe. Shut the dimensional gate once the extraction is complete.

Parallelly, inside the Dark Dimension, Sara’s luck finally ran out. After securing the children in several hidden spots, she ran desperately in the opposite direction to find a way out. It worked too well. Eldora materialized
from the shadows, striking Sara down instantly.

Sara awoke strapped to an archaic, deeply terrifying chamber inside Kera’s private quarters—a highly decayed, rotting room decorated in a creeping, pitch-black aesthetic. Thick, biomechanical wires snaked from a dark, unidentifiable space directly into her chamber. Sara was forcibly injected with a paralytic, forcing her eyes shut to sleep, to be drained.
Parallelly, Team Delta raced to the dark room loaded with strong electric stabbers and shotguns. At the same time, Teams Alpha, Beta, Gamma, and Zeta raced against time into the underground lab.
As they reached the lab, Team Beta immediately secured the main

entrance. Team Alpha charged fearlessly through the glowing, unstable dimensional gate. Team Gamma locked onto the server banks, fingers flying across keyboards, while Teren sprinted toward Thomas’s pod to set him free. Finally, Team Zeta (Trinity) stood by the shimmering threshold, ready to shut the gate, waiting to help Team Beta defend against the entities coming in rage mode.

Parallelly, deep in the Dark Dimension, Sara fought the chemical sleep. With a monumental surge of willpower, she refused the eerie place, violently tearing the wires from her body. She broke out of the chamber, making a run in a desperate, galloping manner through the ash-fall.
Parallelly, inside the dark dimension, Team Alpha went in search of the abducted children. Outside, at the lab entrance, Team Beta fought each and every entity arriving in a fierce wave.

Vikram was thrown off by an entity in a violent manner. He crashed into a wall. But as he didn't feel pain, he quickly reconciled and launched back into the fray, his fists destroying the entities. Varun shot each and every entity with his flamethrower continuously in pure rage. An entity managed to attack Varun, slicing into him, but in a moment, his body regenerated into its normal form, and he fought back relentlessly.
Chase and Ron together hacked all the systems there, starting to download the entire project,
experiments, and trials they had been conducting. Alongside them, Teren and Mike tried to break Thomas out of his chamber but failed.
Teren to Chase: "Chase, can you try to open this chamber?"
Chase to Teren: "That is too complicated, I can't. It's protected."
Mike to Ron: "Protected by what?"
Ron to Mike: "We don't know, but something strange is protecting this chamber... and it’s trying to enter inside Thomas's body."
Teren to the Team: "It's too much of a risk to keep him like this, we need to take him out immediately! His body is trembling to something."
Vikram, overhearing this intense discussion, walked straight to
Thomas's chamber. Without hesitation, he disconnected the wires and force-breaks the thick glass. Thomas fell out of the chamber with the sticky fluids all over his body.
Alongside this chaos, Dr. Sebastin took up his mobile to call his possessed agents to take down Trinity. Suddenly, Dr. Khen allegedly disconnected the call.
Dr. Khen to Dr. Sebastin: "I need the girl alive. I will multiply her powers. That regenerating capability is what I need."
Sebastin sensed something entirely wrong with Khen. He raised his pistol and shot him on sight.
Dr. Sebastin to Dr. Khen's falling body: "This time, you can't come alive."

Parallelly, in the isolation room, Diya, Payal, and Chan used their electric stabbers to trigger out the dark matter inside Krish in a consistent, unrelenting manner. Alongside them, Shaun and Brandt set up an intense trap inside and outside the room, standing ready to fire the horrors into ashes.

A grippy group of entities arose from the ground to attack them. Shaun and Brandt defended the room from inside to outside respectively, firing their shotguns and blasting the creatures into ashes. Wave after wave, the grueling process continued.
Parallelly, inside the lab, Thomas woke to a conscious state. He looked up and saw Dr. Khen dead on the floor.
Thomas to the Team: "He has

been possessed by that dark matter. The saliva sample which Ajay sent us to the lab contained an alien matter inside it. It required a body to sustain. So it chose Dr. Khen and possessed him. The strange man shot him not to kill him, but only to suck the alien matter back outside, which made him collapse suddenly."
Vikram to Thomas: "How do you know all this?"

Thomas to Vikram: "I don't know, but these things all just flashed inside my mind the moment I touched Dr. Khen's hands just before he collapsed in front of me. When I was inside this chamber, I created an illusionary world by myself; it looked real somewhat. There, I was defending some dark
matters from being injected into my mind."
Vikram to himself: "This is all strange..."
Trinity walked near Thomas and touched him gently. Instantly, his tiredness was gone, leaving him completely refreshed.
Trinity to Thomas: "Can you control this situation along with me?"
Thomas to Trinity: "Yes."
He stepped forward, extending his hands. Through sheer supernatural power, he took control of the charging entities, freezing them in their tracks and bending them to his will.
Parallelly, inside the dark dimension, Team Alpha saw the children running for their lives. The rescue force successfully brought the children out

of the gate safely. But Ajay refused to leave, going deeper in search of Sara. Outside the gate, in the real world, Trinity got ready to close it, but she was weak from using her power for so long. Thomas stepped up beside her to help close the gate partially, holding it open just enough because Ajay was still inside the other dimension.

Parallelly, Diya, Payal, and Chan at last forced the dark matter completely out of Krish's body. The black mass flew out into the air, magnetically drawn out of the room, and entered the dark dimension itself. The team relaxed, hugging each other in overwhelming joy. Shaun and Brandt saw the silence and relaxed too. But Diya, fiercely intending on checking on Vikram, ran into the underground lab while the
rest stayed behind.
Back in the lab, the energy was critical.
Trinity to the Team: "We can't hold this for so long! It's unstable, we need to close it! Someone go and bring Ajay back!"
Diya approached, seeing that the immediate situation was contained.
Diya to Trinity: "I can go inside."
Thomas to Diya: "There is no way for a large group as the opening is smaller. Let her do it."
Just then, the agents called by Dr. Sebastin approached with heavy weapons.
Varun to Vikram: "Why are the top agents supporting the bad people?"
Vikram to Varun: "Because they are too possessed by the dark
matter."
Saying that, Vikram and Varun threw themselves into the fight, defending against the agents and brutally keeping them away from Trinity and Thomas.
Alongside this, Diya stepped inside the dark dimension. She scanned the ash-filled horizon until she spotted him.
Diya to Ajay: "Come back, Ajay! The gate is unstable, they need to close it!"
Ajay to Diya: "The children said that a lady rescued them. It must be Sara, I knew it!"
A bit later, both of them saw Sara running desperately toward them. Her face lit up on seeing Ajay and Diya.
Alongside, Eldora saw Sara and raced fiercely toward her.

Suddenly, Diya's blood ran cold. She saw two figures—a lady (who was distinctly not Helen) and a strange man spawning out of thin air, standing right behind Sara in a faded, out-focused manner. Diya was astonished.
Diya to Ajay: "Ajay... are you seeing this?" she asked in a trembled way.
Ajay to Diya: "No. What do you see?"
The ghostly apparition of the strange man raised his hand.
The Strange Man to Sara: "Sara, come here."
Sara turned back, only to be utterly astonished.
Sara to the Strange Man: "This is strange... how does this happen?"
Suddenly, a strong, blinding light

beam shot from the strange man's hand directly against Sara. She dilapidated instantly, collapsing and lying dead in front of Diya and Ajay on the spot. The stray energy of the strange man's light beam also attacked Eldora, making the monster weak enough to disappear from that place.

Ajay's world shattered. He screamed, dropping to his knees and taking her lifeless body into his lap, sobbing uncontrollably as he started grieving. The strange man and lady vanished suddenly into thin air. Ajay and Diya, entirely broken, returned to the real world carrying Sara’s body without a soul. Everyone in the lab saw them emerge and instantly mourned for Sara, the heavy silence of the room
suffocating them all.
After all this, Trinity and Thomas extended their supernatural strength to the maximum level and SHUT THE GATE SUCCESSFULLY. The shockwave rattled the entire facility.
Dr. Sebastin, seeing his master plan ruined, was consumed by absolute anger and rage. He pointed his pistol directly toward the exhausted Trinity and fired.
On looking at this, Ajay—his heart already dead from losing Sara—ran forward. He threw himself in the path of the bullet. It pierced Ajay's heart, and he collapsed onto the ground.
Vikram rushed to him, frantically keeping him on his lap. Ajay looked up, his voice broken and low.
Ajay to Vikram: "I couldn't help her... but I can save at least Trinity for a good cause. Protect her..."
With a final, faint breath, Ajay fainted in Vikram's lap, dying peacefully.

With the gate closed, the agents who had been possessed by the dark matters now slowly regained their own consciousness, dropping their weapons. The Chief of the agents, realizing the nightmare, ordered his subordinates to arrest Dr. Sebastin for his evil, illegal scientific trials.
Chase and Ron stepped forward, handing over the hard drives containing the evidence and details of all the experiment trials which they hacked and retrieved.
Chase to the Chief: "It could be

more helpful to you, and absolutely against Dr. Sebastin." Outside, the storm broke. The rescue teams arrived, and the parents finally reunited with their children. Tears of spreading relief washed over every face as they hugged their kids tight. The Sentinels gathered together, bruised and grieving, but looking at the closed gate in a victorious manner.
The Sentinels to each other: "We won the battle."
In between all this, Shaun saw Diya talking to Vikram in an estranged manner and sighed deeply. Brandt walked up beside him.
Brandt to Shaun: "Is there any improvement in your love life?" He asked, looking over at Diya.
Shaun to Brandt: "He is far

better than me for her in all ways. His efforts to safeguard her, win her back, and also act as a premium-level guardian angel to her is ULTIMATE. There is nothing we can do to match with his capabilities, Brandt. So leaving her on her own decision is the righteous way."
On listening to this, Brandt's expression changed to profound respect. He gave Shaun a tight, friendly hug.
Brandt to Shaun: "Go, find your best life partner and live heartful for her." With a pat on the back, Brandt left him in peace.
Alongside, Vikram and Diya stood together. The walls between them had completely fallen. They shared their first long kiss with a deep emotion,
pulling back to look into each other's eyes with no words needed—only strong, deep love completely filling their gaze.
On seeing this, Varun and Krish, the brothers of Vikram and Diya respectively, got so excited and happy.
Varun to Krish: "Hope we must get ready for another get-together!"
Krish to Varun: "Yes, this is an auspicious wedding season for us!" he added in a joking and cheerful manner.

Both laughed in a joyful manner for their reunion at last. The scene expanded, the camera panning away from the survivors and up into the bright, clear sky, ending the blood-soaked day in a good vibe and happiness surrounded.

title: POST CREDIT SCENE:
content: Inside the pitch-black void of the dark dimension, a single light flickers on.

Diya's body is kept strapped inside an archaic chamber. Some undefined, wildly unstable, and tremendous energy violently enters Diya's body through the glowing wires. The vital monitors spike in an extreme, terrifying manner.
Suddenly, Diya opens her eyes completely wide. They are entirely devoid of humanity. She twitches and responds to KERA'S DISTORTED VOICE actively, a chilling smirk forming on her face.
